verdict.summary: The merge-group override is correctly enforced in both the reusable workflow and the selector itself, takes precedence over shadow mode, and preserves the classify-only early-return behavior. The executable selector tests are non-vacuous: they demonstrate that the same changed-path input remains selected for pull_request but resolves to full/all-members for merge_group. Documentation accurately records the ordered transition and the still-live ALLGREEN setting. The three selector tests passed locally; the wiring test module could not run in this checkout because PyYAML is unavailable, which is an environment dependency rather than a defect in the change.
